ownership.role: Derived review evidence and proposed production timing authority after Gate 1 approval only.

coordinateContract.precision: Window endpoints and source/local offsets are exact. Detector sourceSample is observation time; localFrame is the nearest scheduling frame and may differ by at most 400 samples (half a 60 fps frame).

provenanceContract.section: detector hypothesis plus measured normalized novelty strength
provenanceContract.beat: beat hypothesis with inherited track confidence 0.092826
provenanceContract.phrase: deterministically derived from every eighth hypothesized beat; inherits beat confidence
provenanceContract.transient: 20 fps detector-bin-center hypothesis with measured strength and nearest 60 fps scheduling frame
provenanceContract.energyOpportunity: deterministic local extremum over inherited one-second loudness bins; ranked by loudness then earliest frame; equal-valued alternatives exposed
provenanceContract.intent: authored proposed production intent; confidence is human-required, never numeric

acts.title: Threshold and restraint
acts.productionIntent: Establish a sparse visual identity, preserve negative space, and contract toward the first decisive change.

acts.title: First full statement
acts.productionIntent: Reveal the primary rhythmic system and stabilize it without spending the production peak.

acts.title: Contrast and rebuild
acts.productionIntent: Pull density and brightness back, then rebuild motion and scale into the next structural turn.

acts.title: Suspended evolution
acts.productionIntent: Evolve composition and camera language across sustained energy while retaining final-act headroom.

acts.title: Final statement and release
acts.productionIntent: Accumulate the clearest production peak, then make the ending feel authored through a concise release.
